---
title: "tryCatch(warning = ) abandons the computation at the first warning"
ref: ERR-01
categories: [Errors and files]
impact: silencieux
attendu: "`4`, with a message about the ignored value"
versions: "All"
source: "General R knowledge"
---

::: {.piege}
```{r}
total <- function(x) {
  numbers <- as.numeric(x)
  sum(numbers, na.rm = TRUE)
}
tryCatch(
  total(c("1", "two", "3")),
  warning = function(w) {
    message("Caught: ", conditionMessage(w))
    NA
  }
)
```
:::

## Why

`tryCatch()` is built to exit. As soon as the expected condition is signalled, here the warning from `as.numeric()`, R leaves the current expression, runs the handler, and `tryCatch()` returns whatever the handler returns. The sum is never computed.

You think you are merely intercepting the warning to display it differently, and you are actually replacing the result with `NA`.

## The fix

`withCallingHandlers()` calls the handler without leaving the computation. `invokeRestart("muffleWarning")` then silences the original warning, and execution resumes where it was.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
withCallingHandlers(
  total(c("1", "two", "3")),
  warning = function(w) {
    message("Caught: ", conditionMessage(w))
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }
)
```
:::
